instruction: Move all products with over 4.3 rating from my amazon cart to wish list.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The cart contents are unknown until amazon.show_cart is called, modeled by the knowledge predicate (cart-known) that gates the move action; the static facts (in-cart ?p) and (rating-over-4-3 ?p) mirror the database state that show_cart reveals (rating is read from the cart entries' product info; if the deployed show_cart omits rating, amazon.show_product would be called per cart product). The cart is represented by five placeholder products, three with rating > 4.3 (to be moved) and two at or below 4.3 (must stay in the cart); the real number is determined at runtime from the show_cart response and the plan simply repeats move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list once per qualifying product. Products are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task can carry the full goal conjunction in its precondition. The optional quantity argument of move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list is omitted so the whole cart quantity is moved, matching the expected product_id->quantity mappings. The task asks no question, so complete_task takes no answer.
